methodDetails.scope: Independent current-source full-body supplement for exactly two assigned Web test files, not a claim of complete Web production coverage. No source edits or prior audit outcomes used.

files.web/tests/workflows.test.tsx: Read all 906 lines, including imports, storage/dialog/scroll fixtures, beforeEach/afterEach hooks, every test body and parameterized branch. Reviewed catalogue modes and model selection, explicit steering/queue intent, partial queues, attachment-preserving edits, operation identities and unknown outcomes, duplicate submission locks, retained draft bounds and stale owner/read responses, tab visibility and abort behavior, goal continuation/budget semantics, native ancestry controls, fork/revert/review confirmation and late results, history search/export boundaries, and fixture cleanup. Checked complete assertions against the actual preceding actions and controlled promise completion/rejection.
files.web/tests/organization.test.tsx: Read all 401 lines, including all shared native project/section/thread data, mocked fetch response handling, fixture hooks and every test body/parameterized branch. Reviewed registered-root identity use, metadata-preserving rename, explicit project/section/thread deletion, readiness and idle admission, explicit empty selections, stale read-state revision rejection without replay, project-filtered association paging, tab-hidden form suppression, retained drafts, accepted/unknown delayed operation handling, and API/epoch/thread/project A-to-B-to-A owner changes.

methodDetails.coverage: This supplement supplies complete test-body review in addition to the separate Web reviewer's AST contract review; no previous outcome was treated as evidence for these bodies.
methodDetails.seal: Captured both SHA-256 hashes and snapshot(undefined, true) before review; rehashed both complete files and reran snapshot(undefined, true) over all 1,886 source paths at sealing. Both file hashes and the full source digest stayed unchanged.
